B1.expected_headroom: Closing even half of the ~0.11 absolute standard-online gap would outweigh any single-model gain seen so far.
B1.why: Offline standard overestimates online by 0.11161 (V1) / 0.11667 (V2); validation cannot be trusted for candidate selection until calibrated.

B1.expected_headroom: Class 7 is the dominant residual error bucket with LP accuracy ~0; any recovery is near-pure gain.
Neighbor-LR already shows Class-7 complementarity; fusing graph and feature views targets exactly the bucket LP misses.
B1.why: Complementary signal was observed but never fused.

B1.expected_headroom: Truly differentiated, calibrated panels are a prerequisite for trusting any offline gain above noise.
B1.why: Degree-matched/standard panels undifferentiated; test-like/propensity-matched panels duplicate.

B2.expected_headroom: Novel targets are the majority of the test slice and current recall there is exactly 0; this is the largest single headroom.
B2.why: B2_HISTORY_RECALL only covers history targets; novel majority is unserved.

B2.expected_headroom: A real candidate-level L2R model replaces heuristic stand-ins; gated on lightgbm availability.
B2.why: Candidate Ranker was never a true candidate-level LambdaRank.

B2.expected_headroom: Pool recall @20/50/100/200 makes retrieval headroom measurable and separates retrieval from ranking failure.
B2.why: Retrieval vs ranking failure currently not separable.

B2.expected_headroom: Sparse candidate tables remove the 3.35GiB dense allocation failure and unblock larger candidate pools.
B2.why: Dense float64 full-matrix default caused a 3.35GiB allocation failure.

B2.expected_headroom: Bucket-specialist reranking that actually differs per bucket, instead of degenerating to Popularity.
